English: This chapter describes our experiences in connecting a group of emerging Southern African scholars around the inherently interdisciplinary field of migration, urbanisation and health.
Luganda: Essuula eno ennyonnyola bye tuzudde mu kuyunga ekibinja ky’abayivu b’e South Africa ekipya ku kisaawe ekigatta okusenguka, okusenga mu bibuga n’ebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Orí ìwé yìí ṣàpèjúwe àwọn ìrírí wa nípa ṣíṣe ìsopọ̀ ẹgbẹ́ tó ti inú àwọn ọ̀mọ̀wé Áfíríkà ti apá Gúsù ní àyíká ààyè iṣé ẹ̀ka ìmọ̀ ìrìnrìn àjò tó ju ẹyọ̀kan lọ, àwọn ìlú tó ti lajú àti ìléra.
Zulu: Lesi sahluko sichaza okuhlangenwe nakho kwethu ekuxhumaniseni iqembu lezazi zaseNingizimu Afrika ezisafufusa emkhakheni wemvelo ohlukene wokufuduka, ukufudukela emadolobheni kanye nempilo.
Hausa: Wannan babin yana bayyana abubuwan da muka samu wajen haɗa ƙungiyar ƙwararrun masanan Afirka ta Kudu da suke tasowa a fagagen ƙaura da bunƙasar birane da kuma kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: gaolo ye e hlaloša maitemogelo a rena a go kgokaganya sehlopha sa dirutegi tšeo di sa tšwelelago tša ka Borwa bja Afrika mabapi lekala la mafapha a mantši ka tlhago la bofaladi, go hudugela ditoropong le maphelo.

English: South Africa, as with other countries in the region, is witnessing multiple simultaneous and interconnected transitions – health, demographic, social, economic and political.
Luganda: South Africa, era ng’amawanga amalala mu kitundu, erimu enkyukakyuka nnyingi era ezikwatagana mu kiseera kyekimu – mu byobulamu, ebikwata ku bantu, embeera z’abantu, ebyenfuna n’ebyobufuzi.
Yoruba: South Africa, pẹ̀lú àwọn orílẹ̀ èdè mìíràn ní agbègbè wọn, ni wọ́n ń rí ìlọ́pọ àti ìsopọ̀ àwọn ìyípadà lẹ́ẹ̀kan ná-àn lóri - ìléra, ètò iye àwọn ènìyàn, àwùjọ, ètò ọrọ̀ ajé àti òṣèlú.
Zulu: INingizimu Afrika, njengakwamanye amazwe esifundeni, ibona izinguquko eziningi ngasikhathi sinye nezixhumene - ezempilo, izibalo zabantu, ezenhlalo, ezomnotho kanye nezepolitiki.
Hausa: Afirka ta Kudu, kamar yadda yake a sauran ƙasashe na yankin, ana ganin sauye-sauye na lokaci ɗaya da haɗin kai – lafiya da alƙaluma da zamantakewa da tattalin arziki da kuma siyasa.
Northern Sotho: Afrika Borwa, go swana le dinaga tše dingwe ka mo seleteng se, e itemogela diphetogo tše ntši tšeo di diregago ka nako e tee tšeo di kgokaganego mmogo – e lego ka lefapheng la maphelo, dipalopalo ka ga setšhaba, leago, ekonomi le tša sepolotiki.
Amharic: ደቡብ አፍሪካ እንደሌሉቹ የክልሉ ሃገራት በርካታ ተከታታይ እና ተያያዥነት ያላቸው የጤና፣ የስነ ህዝብ አወቃቀር፣ የማህበራዊ፣ የኢኮኖሚያዊ እና የፖለቲካ ለውጥ ሽግግሮችን እያየች ነው።

English: Defining, measuring and better understanding the dynamics and complexities of these transitions is a fundamental step in the professionalizing of next-generation scholars in the area of migration, urbanisation and health.
Luganda: Okunnyonnyola, okupima n’okutegeera obulungi ebikwata ku nkyukakyuka zino mutendera mukulu mu kukugusa abanoonyereza ab’omulembe ogujja mu kisaawe ky’okusenguka, okusenga mu bibuga n’ebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Kíki oríkì, wíwọ̀n àti níní òye kíkún nípa àwọn ohun tó ń mú ìdàgbàsókè àti àwọn ìlọ́jú ìyípadà jẹ́ ìpele tó ṣe kókó nínú kíkọ àwọn ọ̀mọ̀wé tókàn ní ààyè iṣé ìrìnìn àjò, àwọn ìlú tó ti lajú àti ìléra.
Zulu: Ukuchaza, ukulinganisa nokuqonda kangcono ukuguquguquka nobunkimbinkimbi balezi zinguquko kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile ekwenzeni izifundiswa zezizukulwane ezilandelayo zibe ngochwepheshe endaweni yokufuduka, ukufudukela emadolobheni kanye nempilo.
Hausa: Ma’ana, aunawa da kuma fahintar yadda abubuwa masu sarƙaƙiya da sarƙaƙiyar waɗannan sauye-sauye, mataki ne na asali a cikin ƙwararrun masana na gaba a fannin ƙaura da bunƙasar birane da kuma lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Go hlaloša, go ela le go kwešiša bokaone diphetogo le go hlakahlakana ga diphetogo tše ke kgato ye bohlokwa mabapi le go dira gore dirutegi tše moloko wo o latelago di be tša sephrofešenale ka lekaleng la bofaladi, go hudugela ditoropong le maphelo.
Amharic: የእነዚህን ሽግግሮች ተለወዋጭነት እና ውስብስብነት መለየት፣ መለካት እና በተሻለ ሁኔታ መረዳት የቀጣዩን ትውልድ ምሁራን የስደት፣ የከተማ መስፋፋት እና የጤና ዘርፍ ሙያዊ ብቃትን ለማሳደግ መሰረታዊ እርምጃ ነው።

English: In this chapter we discuss themes, definitions and the process of forming group discourse at the nexus of migration, urbanisation and health.
Luganda: Mu ssuula eno, twogera ku miramwa, ennyinyonnyola n’enkola y’okufunamu ebibinja by’okunoonyereza ku kusenguka, okusenga mu bibuga n’ebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Nínú orí ìwé yìí a sọ̀rọ̀ nípa àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ àkóórí, àwọn oríkì àti ọ̀nà tí à ń gbà láti dá ẹgbẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀ sísọ sílẹ̀ ní nẹ́sùsì ìrìnrìn àjò, àwọn ìlú tó ti lajú àti ìléra.
Zulu: Kulesi sahluko sidingida izindikimba, izincazelo kanye nenqubo yokwenza izingxoxo zeqembu kuxhaxha lokufuduka, ukufudukela emadolobheni nempilo.
Hausa: A wannan babin mun tattauna jigogi, ma’anoni da tsarin samar da zance na rukuni a dangantakar ƙaura da bunƙasar birane da kuma kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Ka mo nkgaolong ye re ahlaahla merero, ditlhalošo le tshepedišo ya go hlama ditherišano tša dihlopha mabapi le bofaladi, go dugela ditoropong le maphelo.
Amharic: በዚህ ምእራፍ ጭብጦችን እና ትርጉሞችን የምንወያይ ሲሆን በስደት፣ በከተማ መስፋፋት እና በጤና ትስስር ላይ የቡድን ወይይት የመፍጠር ሂደትን እንነጋገራለን።

English: Driven by substantive questions derived from studies of the lived experiences of urban migrants in South Africa, specifically the intertwining of migration trajectories and health histories, a central goal of our collaborative endeavour was ‘to connect the dots’ – key concepts, data, measures and methods – in order to identify common themes and research priorities that will facilitate the participation of next-generation scholars in developing innovative and new research agendas.
Luganda: Nga tugoberera ebibuuzo ebiggyibwa mu kunoonyereza ku biyitibwamu abasengusi mu South Africa, naddala okukwatagana kw’amakubo g’okusenguka n’ebyafaayo by’ebyobulamu, ekiruubirirwa ekikulu eky’okukolagana kwaffe kyali ‘okuyunga obubaka’ – ebitegeero ebikulu, obubaka obwekenneenyezebwa, n’enkola – okusobola okuzuula emiramwa emikulu n’ebyetaaga okusoosoowaza mu kunoonyereza ebijja okusobozesa okwetaba kw’abanoonyereza ab’omu maaso mu kukulaakulanya emiramwa gy’okunoonyereza emipya era egy’omulembe.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àwọn ìbéèrè tó ní ìtumọ̀ láti inú àwọn ìwádìí àwọn ìrírí àwọn arìnrìn àjò láti àwon ìlú tó ti lajú ní South Africa, ní pàtó ṣíṣe ìlọ́pọ̀ àwọn ohun ìtọpa ìrìnrìn àjò àti àwọn ìtàn ìléra, àbájáde ìfọwọ́sowọ́pọ̀ ìgbìyànjú wa ni ‘láti so àwọn dọ́ọ̀tì pọ̀’ - àwọn kókó èrò, dátà, àwọn òṣùwọ̀n àti àwọn ọ̀nà - láti dá àwọn àkóórí tó wọ́pọ̀ mọ̀ àti àwọn ìwádìí tó jẹ wá lógún tí ó ma ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún ìkópa àwọn ọ̀mọ̀wé tó ń bọ̀ láti ṣe ìgbàsókè ọgbọ́n tuntun àti àwọn ohun tí a ó sọ̀rọ̀ lé lórí nínú ìwádìí tuntun.
Zulu: Ngokuqhutshwa imibuzo ebambekayo etholakala ocwaningweni lwempilo yabantu abafudukela emadolobheni eNingizimu Afrika, ikakhulukazi ukuhlangana kwezindlela zokufuduka kanye nomlando wezempilo, umgomo oyinhloko womzamo wethu wokubambisana 'kwakuwukuhlanganisa amachashazi' - imiqondo eyinhloko, idatha, izinyathelo kanye izindlela - ukuze kuhlonzwe izindikimba ezivamile kanye nezinto ezibalulekile zocwaningo ezizokwenza lula ukubamba iqhaza kwezazi zesizukulwane esilandelayo ekuthuthukiseni ama-ajenda ocwaningo olusha namasha.
Hausa: Tambayoyi masu mahimmanci da aka samo daga nazarin abubuwan da suka faru na rayuwar baƙin haure a Afirka ta Kudu, musamman ma'amalar ƙaura da tarihin kiwon lafiya, babban burin ƙoƙarin haɗin gwiwarmu shi ne 'domin haɗa bayanai' – mahimman ra'ayoyi da bayanai da matakai da kuma hanyoyi – domin gano jigogi na gama-gari da abubuwan da suka fi dacewa da bincike waɗanda za su sauƙaƙe shigar da masana na gaba dominn haɓaka sababbin abubuwan bincike da kuma sababin ajandojin bincike.
Northern Sotho: Ka ge e hlohleleditwe ke dipotšišo tše mmalwa tše di tšwago go dinyakišišo ka ga maitemogelo ao batho ba kopanego le ona a bafaladi ba go ya ditoropong ka Afrika Borwa, kudukudu go amana ga seemo sa bofaladi le dihistori ka ga maphelo, nepo ye bohlokwa ya maitekelo a rena a tirišano e bile ‘go kopanyo tshedimošo’– dikgopolo tše bohlokwa, tshedimošo ye e bolokilwego, magato le mekgwa – ka nepo ya go hlatha merero ye e swanago le dilo tša dinyakišišo tšeo di beilwego pele tšeo di tlago nolofatša go kgatha tema ga dirutegi tša moloko wo o latelago mabapi le go hlama mananeo a maswa le a boitlhamelo a dinyakišišo.
Amharic: በደቡብ አፍሪካ ካሉ የከተማ ስደተኞች የህይወት ተሞክሮ በተገኙ ተጨባጭ ጥያቄዎች በተለይም ከስደት አቅጣጫዎች እና ከጤና ታሪኮች ዋናው ግባችን 'ነጥቦቹን ማገናኘት' ነበር -  ቁልፍ ጽንሰ ሃሳቦችን፣ የዳታ ልኬቶችን እና ዘዴዎችን - ይህም የቀጣይ ትውልድ ምሁራን በፈጠራ የተሞሉ እና አዳዲስ የምርምር አጀንዳዎችን እንዲያዘጋጁ ለመርዳት የጋራ ጭብጦችን እና ቅድሚያ ሊሰጧቸው የሚገቡ ምርምሮችን መለየት እንዲቹሉ ለማድረግ ነበር፡፡

English: We report on the themes that emerged from a 2015 workshop held at the University of the Witwatersrand in Johannesburg that brought together senior and early-career scholars to discuss ways of engaging with migration, urbanisation and health in the Southern African context.
Luganda: Twogera ku miramwa egyava mu musomo gwa 2015 ogwali mu University of the Witwatersrand mu Johannesburg ogwaleeta awamu abanoonyereza abakugu n’abatandika okwogera ku ngeri z’okukwatamu okusenguka, okusenga mu bibuga n’ebyobulamu mu kitundu ky’Obukiikaddyo bwa Africa.
Yoruba: A jábọ̀ àwọn àkóórí tí ó ti inú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ ti ọdún 2015 tó wáyé ní University Witwatersrand ní Johannesburg tó mú àwọn ọ̀mọ̀wè àgbà àti àwọn ọ̀mọ̀wé tó ṣè bẹ̀rẹ̀ iṣẹ́-ǹ-ṣe láti jíròrò lóri àwọn ọ̀nà láti kópa pẹ̀lú ìrìnrìn àjò, àwọn ìlú tó ti lajú àti ìléra nínú ètò kíkà ní apá Gúsù ilẹ̀ Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Sibika ngezindikimba ezavela emhlanganweni wokucobelelana ngolwazi wezi-2015 owawuseNyuvesi yaseWitwatersrand eGoli owawuhlanganise osolwazi abaphezulu nabasakhula ukuze kuxoxwe ngezindlela zokusebenzisana nokufuduka kwabantu emadolobheni kanye nempilo eNingizimu Afrika.
Hausa: Muna bayar da rahoto kan jigogins da suka fito daga wani taron bita na shekarar 2015 da aka gudanar a Jami’ar Witwatersrand da take Johannesburg wanda ya tattaro manyan malamai da masanan farko-farko domin tattaunawa a kan hanyoyin cuɗanya da ƙaura da bunƙasar birane a kuma kiwon lafiya a cikin yanayin Kudancin Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Re fa pego ka ga merero yeo e tšweletšego go tšwa wekešopong ye e swerwego ka 2015 ye e swaretšwego ka Yunibesithing ya Witwatersrand ka Johannesburg ye e ilego ya kopanya mmogo dirutegi tša godingwana le tšeo di sa thomago mošomo go ahlaahla ditsela tša go rerišana ka ga bofaladi, go hudugela ditoropong le ka maphelo ka seemong sa Borwa bja Afrika.
Amharic: በጆሃንስበርግ በዊትዋተርስታንድ ዩኒቨርሲቲ ሲኒየር እና በስራቸው መጀመሪያ ላይ ያሉ ምሁራንን ባሰባሰበው ስደትን፣ የከተማ መስፋፋትን እና ጤናን በደቡብ አፍሪካዊ ዘውግ የሚያሳትፉ አካሄዶች ላይ በ2015 ከተደረገው አውደ ጥናት የወጡትን ጭብጦች እንዘግባለን።

English: We close with a discussion of the opportunities and challenges for early-career scholars in this field, identifying next steps to develop and sustain in-country capacity to influence both research and public policy.
Luganda: Tukomekkereza n’okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku mikisa n’okusoomoozebwa eby’abanoonyereza abato mu kisaawe kino, nga tulaga emitendera egiddako egy’okukulaakulanya n’okubeezaawo obusobozi bw’omunda mu ggwanga okufuga eby’okunoonyereza n’enkola y’amateeka.
Yoruba: A parí pẹ̀lú ìjíròrò lóri àwọn àǹfàní àti àwọn ìdojúkọ fún àwọn ọ̀mọ̀wé ní àárọ̀ ọjọ́ iṣẹ́-ǹ-ṣe wọn ní ààyè yìí, títọ́ka sí àwọn ìpele tó kàn láti ṣe ìdàgbàsókè àti ìrànlọ́wọ́ nínú agbára orílè èdè kan láti ní ipa lóri ìwádìí àti ìlànà òfin àwùjọ.

Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣàkíyèsí pé àwọn ìsòrò kan wà lóri ìwádìí ní àwọn ìlú tó ti lajú, ìrìnrìn àjò àti ìtọ́jú ìléra àwọn arìnrìn àjò.
Zulu: Baqaphele ukuthi kunezinkinga ezithile ngocwaningo lokufudukela emadolobheni, ukufuduka kanye nokunakekelwa kwezempilo kwabokufika.
Hausa: Sun yi nuni da cewa, akwai wasu matsalolin da suka shafi bincike a bunƙasar birane da ƙaura da kuma kula da lafiyar baƙin haure.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba lemoga gore go na le mathata ka ga dinyakišišo tša mabapi le go hudugela ditoropong, bofaladi le tlhokomelo ya maphelo go bafaladi.

English: For example, it is difficult for research to inform policies and practices, and researchers in these fields use different terminology and jargon so it can be hard to communicate.
Luganda: Okugeza, kizibu okunoonyereza okutereeza enkola n’ebikolebwa, era abanoonyereza mu bisaawe bino bakozesa ebimiimo n’olulimi olw’enjawulo noolwekyo kiba kizibu okuwuliziganya.
Yoruba: Fún àpẹẹrẹ, ó nira fún ìwádìí láti ròyìn àwọn ìlànà àti ìgbaradì, àti pé àwọn aṣèwádìí ní ààyè iṣẹ́ yìí má ń lo oríṣiríṣi ìmọ̀-ìjìnlẹ̀ ọ̀rọ̀ àti àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó nira kó ba lè le láti báni sọ̀rọ̀.
Zulu: Isibonelo, kunzima ukuthi ucwaningo lwazise izinqubomgomo nezinqubo, futhi abacwaningi kule mikhakha basebenzisa amagama ahlukene kanye ne-jargon ukuze kube nzima ukuxhumana.
Hausa: Alal misali, yana da wahala bincike ya sanar da manufofi da ayyuka, kuma masu bincike a cikin waɗannan fagagen suna amfani da kalmomi da jargon daban-daban don haka, yana da wahala a iya sadarwa.
Northern Sotho: Go fa mohlala,go bothata gore dinyakišišo go thuša ka ga tlhamo ya melawana le ka ditiro, gomme banyakišiši ka mo makaleng a ba šomiša mareo ao a fapanego le mmolelo gore go be boima go bolela ka ga ona.
Amharic: ይህ ለጤና አጠባበቅ አገልግሎቶች ለእነዚህ ታካሚዎች የተሻለውን እንክብካቤ ለመስጠት አስቸጋሪ ያደርግባቸዋል፣ እና ለራሳቸው ለታካሚዎቹም ጤናቸውን መቆጣጠር ከባድ ያደርግባቸዋል።

English: In the workshop, the general feeling was that these social challenges need researchers from different fields to work together.
Luganda: Mu musomo ogwo, endowooza ey’awamu yali nti okusoomoozebwa kuno okw’embeera z’abantu kwetaaga abanoonyereza okuva mu bisaawe eby’enjawulo okukolera awamu.
Yoruba: Nínú ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ yìí, àpapọ̀ ìmọ̀lára ni pé àwọn ìdojúkọ àwùjọ nílò àwọn aṣèwádìí láti oríṣiríṣi ààyè láti ṣiṣẹ́ papọ̀.
Zulu: Eshabhu, umuzwa ojwayelekile wawuwukuthi lezi zinselele zomphakathi zidinga abacwaningi abavela emikhakheni ehlukene ukuze sebenzani ndawonye.

Northern Sotho: Ka wekešopong, maikutlo ka kakaretšo e bile gore ditlhohlo tše tša setšhaba di hloka banyakišiši go tšwa ka makaleng ao a fapanego gore ba šomišane mmogo.

English: Some programmes already include student training for social and health studies.
Luganda: Pulogulaamu ezimu zirimu okutendeka abayizi mu kunoonyereza ku mbeera z’abantu n’ebyobulamu.
Yoruba: Àwọn ètò mìíràn ti ṣàfikún ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ fún àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ lóri àwọn ìwádìí àwùjọ àti ìlera.

Northern Sotho: Mananeo a mangwe a šetše a akaretša tlhahlo ya baithuti go dinyakišišo ka ga setšhaba le tša maphelo.
Amharic: አንዳንድ ፕሮግራሞች አስቀድመው የተማሪዎችን የማህበራዊ እና የጤና ስልጠናዎች ያካትታሉ።

English: The authors said the workshop helped researchers connect to one another by encouraging open discussions.
Luganda: Abawandiisi baagamba nti omusomo guno gwayamba abanoonyereza okukwatagana ne bannaabwe nga gubaagazisa okukubaganya ebirowoozo okutaliimu kukugirwa.
Yoruba: Àwọn akọ̀wé yìí sọ pé ìdánilẹ́kọ̀ọ́ yìí ṣe ìrànlọ́wọ́ fún àwọn aṣèwádìí láti mọ ara wọn nípa gbígba ìjíròrò láàyè.

Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore wekešopo e thušitše banyakišiši go kgokagana le ba bangwe ka go hlohleletša dipoledišano tša phatlalatša.
Amharic: ጸሃፊዎቹ አውደ ጥናቱ ግልጽ ውይይቶችን በማበረታታት ተመራማሪዎች እርስ በእርስ እንዲገናኙ ረድቷል ብለዋል።

English: But collaborative research needs a lot of time and effort from all the researchers involved.
Luganda: Naye okukolagana mu kunoonyereza kwetaaga obudde bungi n’amaanyi okuva mu banoonyereza bonna abakwetabamu.
Yoruba: Àmọ́ àjọṣepọ̀ ìwádìí nílò àsìkò tó pọ̀ àti ìgbìnyànjú láti ọ̀dọ gbogbo àwọn aṣèwádìí tí wọ́n lọ́wọ́ nínú ìwádìí náà.
Zulu: Kodwa ucwaningo lokusebenzisana ludinga isikhathi esiningi nomzamo ovela kubo bonke abacwaningi abahilelekile.

Northern Sotho: Eupša dinyakišišo tša tirišano di hloka nako ye ntši le matsapa go tšwa go banyakišiši ka moka bao ba kgathago tema.
Amharic: ነገር ግን የትብብር ምርምር ከሁሉም ተሳታፊ ተመራማሪዎች ብዙ ጊዜን እና ጥረትን ይፈልጋል።

English: More things can be done, like student and staff exchange programmes and mentoring, to help encourage research in urbanisation, migration and health across fields.
Luganda: Waliwo ebintu ebirala ebisobola okukolebwa, ng’okuwaanyisiganya abayizi n’abakozi awamu n’okulondoola, okuyamba okutumbula okunoonyereza ku kusenga mu bibuga, okusenguka n’ebyobulamu mu bisaawe eby’enjawulo.
Yoruba: A lè ṣe ọ̀pọ̀ nǹkan, bíi kí àwọn akẹ́kọ̀ọ́ àti òṣìṣẹ́ ṣe pàṣípàrọ̀ àwọn ètò àti ṣíṣàmójútó, láti ṣe iranlọwọ ìgbìyànjú ìwádìí ní àwọn ìlú tó ti lajú, ìrìnrìn àjò àti ìléra kárí gbogbo ààyè.
Zulu: Ziningi izinto ezingenziwa, njengezinhlelo zokushintshana kwabafundi nabasebenzi kanye nokwelulekwa, ukusiza ukukhuthaza ucwaningo ngokufudukela emadolobheni, ukufuduka kanye nempilo kuyo yonke imikhakha.
Hausa: Ana iya yin ƙarin abubuwa, kamar shirye-shiryen musayar ɗalibai da ma’aikata da kuma jagoranci, domin taimakawa ƙarfafa bincike a fannin ƙaura da bunƙasar birane da kuma kiwon lafiya a tsakanin fagage.
Northern Sotho: Dilo tše ntši di ka dirwa, go swana le mananeo a neelano a baithuti le a bašomi le go ba hlahla, go thuša go hlohleletša dinyakišišo mabapi le go hudugela ditoropong, bofaladi le maphelo go ralala le makala ka moka.

English: This report highlights the need for researchers from social fields to come together and inform policies and regulations to ensure positive health responses to migrants in Africa.
Luganda: Alipoota eno eyogera ku bwetaavu bw’abanoonyereza mu bisaawe by’embeera z’abantu okusobola okutereeza enkola n’ebiragiro okulaba ng’abasenze mu Africa bafuna ebyobulamu ebirungi.
Yoruba: Ìròyìn yìí ṣàfihàn ìnílò fún àwọn aṣèwádìí láti àwọn ààyè kan láwùjọ láti wá pọ̀ láti ròyìn àwọn ìlànà láti rí àrídájú ìdáhùn sí ìléra tó dára fún àwọn arìnrìn àjò ní Áfíríkà.
Zulu: Lo mbiko uqokomisa isidingo sokuthi abacwaningi abavela emikhakheni yezenhlalakahle bahlangane futhi bazise izinqubomgomo nemithethonqubo ukuqinisekisa izimpendulo ezinhle zezempilo kubafuduki e-Afrika.
Hausa: Wannan rahoto ya nuna buƙatar masu bincike daga fannonin zamantakewar jama'a su haɗu tare da sanar da manufofi da ƙa'idoji don tabbatar da kyakkyawan amsoshin kiwon lafiya ga baƙin haure a Afirka.
Northern Sotho: Pego ye e ahlaahla tlhokego ya gore banyakišiši go tšwa ka makaleng a setšhaba go kopana mmogo le go hlama melawana le ditshepedišo go netefatša gore go ba le diphetolo tše kaone tša maphelo tša mabapi le bafaladi ka Afrika.
